title: Letter to Fanny Brawne, 8 July 1819
author: John Keats
rights: 美国：1878 年出版；中国：作者1821 年去世，保护期已满
intro: 1819年7月8日，约翰·济慈写给恋人范妮·布劳恩的信。信中既有热烈的爱意，也有对美与爱情的思索，句子长，用词偏古雅，拼写也保留了旧式写法。济慈写信时二十多岁，文字热烈，朗读时可随情绪起伏调整语速和停顿。
tips: “my love of Beauty” 一句较长，在 love 后停顿，突出对美的热爱。
“'twill” 是 it will 的旧式缩写，读成短促的 twil 即可。

segments.text: My Sweet Girl: Your Letter gave me more delight than any thing in the world but yourself could do; indeed I am almost astonished that any absent one should have that luxurious power over my senses which I feel.
Even when I am not thinking of you I receive your influence and a tenderer nature stealing upon me.
All my thoughts, my unhappiest days and nights have I find not at all cured me of my love of Beauty, but made it so intense that I am miserable that you are not with me:
or rather breathe in that dull sort of patience that cannot be called Life.
I never knew before, what such a love as you have made me feel, was; I did not believe in it; my Fancy was afraid of it, lest it should burn me up.
But if you will fully love me, though there may be some fire, 'twill not be more than we can bear when moistened and bedewed with pleasures.
